description: Liste des gares et zones associées de la tarification multimodale zonale T-libr is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Syndicat des mobilités des territoires de l'aire métropolitaine lyonnaise. List of T-libr multimodal zonal charging stations and associated zones. T-libr multimodal zonal pricing is driven by the SMT AML with its members. It allows, on a single ticket and a single support, to borrow several urban and interurban networks, in particular TER Auvergne-Rhône-Alpes, around Lyon, Saint-Etienne, Vienne Condrieu, L'Isle-d'Abeau - Bourgoin-Jallieu, Miribel - Montluel. Coverage: Syndicat des mobilités des territoires de l'aire métropolitaine lyonnaise. The portal shows the English title as "List of T-libr multimodal zonal charging stations and associated zones" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Syndicat des mobilités des territoires de l'aire métropolitaine lyonnaise. Its keywords include lva, stas, colibri, ccmp-miribel, cars-du-rhone, tcl. The listing shows 1 download or service links in CSV. The listing shows 2023-12-11 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
